tools.name: list_calls
tools.description:
Your calls of priced tools, newest first; tool ("titles", ...) narrows. Same as GET

tools.name: find_similar

tools.name: search_thumbnails

    (image_url: read once by the model as subject, action, words and setting, then

tools.name: preview_package

Your package in a mock YouTube feed among a run's winners: view home, search, sidebar,

tools.name: make_thumbnails
tools.description:
Make 2 to 12 thumbnails (default 4): 3 different concepts first, then images (Nano

tools.name: get_thumbnails
tools.description:
A thumbnails call: status, concepts and every image so far (url signed for 7 days,

tools.name: edit_thumbnail
tools.description:
Edit one thumbnail (an image of your thumbnails call, or a picture you send): op erase,
    edit, face_swap, text, text_variations, upscale, fix, crop or color. crop and color are

tools.name: recreate_thumbnail
tools.description:
New thumbnails for your video with a YouTube video's own thumbnail as the layout

    POST /v1/thumbnails/recreate; read it with get_thumbnails.

tools.name: optimize_video
tools.description:
New packages (4, 8 or 12) for your published video: the original scored first against
    the real outliers on its subject, then each new package (title, thumbnail with every word

tools.name: get_optimize
tools.description:
An Optimize call: the original's score and every new package so far. Same as GET

tools.name: ab_set

Pack 2 or 3 images of one of your thumbnails, edit or Optimize calls for YouTube

tools.name: get_find

One result of a long or packaging run with every field: the video, its numbers and

    Returns {"find_id", "verdict": null}. Clearing a find with no decision is the same

tools.name: list_finds

The index: every video your long and packaging runs found, across all runs, one

tools.name: get_remix
tools.description:
One remix you paid for (from remix_hook, remix_find or a chat turn), as its answer

tools.name: list_kept_finds

The videos you kept with keep_find (long-form hooks and packages), newest decision

tools.name: get_hook

One hook with every field: its opening line, transcript, watch_url and the

tools.name: embed_hook

Official TikTok or Instagram embed HTML for a hook, so the clip plays inside your
